title: The check presses buttons once per view type
quote: Start simpler: check the page layout states, one per view type. We can fine-tune it later; now we want speed.
means: theOS's check still checks every state it reaches for layout, but presses buttons only in the first state of each view type, one button of each kind, so a run stays fast (1,243 states, 228 view types, about 80 s). Identical buttons that open different content are not all pressed: that case is written into aip-31df's gaps, to be tuned later. Samuel also had review round 4 run, whose findings are fixed.

supersedes.part: buttons told apart by state, position and markup; no fourth round
supersedes.what: Buttons are pressed once per view type, and a fourth review round ran at Samuel's word.

reflection.checked: every decision before d-5afb that held
